svg.text: Metadata, semantic model, knowledge base, ontology, knowledge graph or lineage?

links found in the repo's files
One question, every dimension contributes: “What was revenue from premium customers in Electronics?”
use the price paid, not list
answer: 1498.97, all from Alice Johnson's orders: Laptop Pro 14, 2 × USB-C Charger 65W (O1) and Wireless Earbuds X (O3)
from and what depends on it
they overlap: give each piece of meaning one source of truth, and make the others reference it
